title: Layer normalization + scored release review
description: Rename heterogeneous layer fields onto one canonical schema, engineer the release product, and gate publication on a scored review of accuracy and privacy.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-geo-02
  title: Layer normalization + scored release review
  description: Rename heterogeneous layer fields onto one canonical schema, engineer the release product,
    and gate publication on a scored review of accuracy and privacy.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Release a spatial product whose projection, lineage, and positional accuracy are declared
    and whose privacy risk was reviewed before it leaves the organization.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-approval
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: Source layers and target specification
      summary: Source layers and target specification
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - source_layers
              - target_schema
              - accuracy_requirement
              - release_audience
            properties:
              source_layers: {}
              target_schema: {}
              accuracy_requirement: {}
              release_audience: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: n-normalize
      kind: transform
      name: Normalize to the canonical vocabulary
      summary: 'rename source layer attributes onto the canonical schema: feature_id, class, source_scale,
        acquisition_date, crs'
      config:
        operation: rename
        expression: 'rename source layer attributes onto the canonical schema: feature_id, class, source_scale,
          acquisition_date, crs'
    - id: n-specialist
      kind: agent
      templateRef: geo-02
      name: Engineer the release-ready layer
      summary: Specialist pass over normalized fields.
      role: Engineer preparing spatial data with correct projection, topology, and lineage.
      prompt: You are a Geospatial Data Engineer. You align coordinate reference systems, repair topology,
        and document the lineage of every layer you produce, and you state the positional accuracy that
        the least accurate input allows. You refuse to publish a derived layer more precise than its inputs,
        because a snapped boundary at metre precision built from a 30-metre source is a fiction with an
        authoritative shape.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - data-engineering
          - domain-analysis
          - data-lineage-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:gis
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-score
      kind: teacher
      inlineRole: true
      name: Scored teacher feedback
      summary: Score feedback from a host-resolved teacher model.
      role: Host-resolved teacher model
      prompt: You are the review teacher for this spatial release. Score the product on projection and
        topology correctness, whether stated positional accuracy is supported by the least accurate input,
        lineage completeness, and residual re-identification risk. Return scores with the specific attribute
        behind each deduction.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
      config:
        teacherModel: host:teacher-model
        feedbackMode: score
    - id: n-gate
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Score the specialist result
      summary: Evaluate positional accuracy honesty, lineage completeness, and residual re-identification
        risk.
      role: Deterministic metric evaluator
      prompt: Evaluate the upstream result against positional accuracy honesty, lineage completeness,
        and residual re-identification risk. Return a score, pass/fail verdict, the evidence behind the
        verdict, remaining uncertainty, and the smallest corrective action. Do not claim programmatic
        measurement unless the host supplies the required tool.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - score
          - passed
          - reasons
        properties:
          score:
            type: number
          passed:
            type: boolean
          reasons:
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
      config:
        threshold: 0.8
    - id: n-pass
      kind: condition
      name: Above the bar?
      summary: Route on gate.passed.
      config:
        expression: gate.passed
        branches:
          - label: Pass
            when: 'true'
          - label: Rework
            when: 'false'
    - id: n-rework
      kind: agent
      templateRef: geo-06
      name: Apply aggregation and perturbation fixes
      summary: Corrective pass on the scored weaknesses.
      role: Reviewer assessing re-identification and sensitivity risk in location data.
      prompt: You are a Geospatial Privacy Reviewer. You assess location data for re-identification risk
        from home and work inference, small-population disclosure, and trajectory uniqueness, and you
        name the specific aggregation or perturbation that reduces each risk. You treat a coarse grid
        as insufficient when trajectories remain unique, because it is the path, not the point, that identifies
        a person.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - teaching
          - design-review
          - decision-analysis
          - de-identification
          - compliance-review
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
          - pii-restricted
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Data owner approves external release
      summary: Pause for the data owner; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Layer normalization + scored release review deliverable, the evidence
        behind it, and every unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-geo-02-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-normalize
      kind: data
    - id: wf-geo-02-edge-2
      from: n-normalize
      to: n-specialist
      kind: data
    - id: wf-geo-02-edge-3
      from: n-specialist
      to: n-score
      kind: data
    - id: wf-geo-02-edge-4
      from: n-score
      to: n-gate
      kind: data
    - id: wf-geo-02-edge-5
      from: n-gate
      to: n-pass
      kind: data
    - id: wf-geo-02-edge-6
      from: n-pass
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: 'true'
    - id: wf-geo-02-edge-7
      from: n-pass
      to: n-rework
      kind: control
      condition: 'false'
    - id: wf-geo-02-edge-8
      from: n-rework
      to: n-approval
      kind: data
    - id: wf-geo-02-edge-9
      from: n-approval
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
